column1: Which is the true religion, Islam or Christian?
column3: The Westminster Catechism states that, “The chief purpose of man is to glorify God and enjoy Him forever.” This is what the Bible teaches. I have not read anywhere in the Quran that we are to enjoy God, especially as this enjoyment is relational. As to which is the ‘true religion’ we will only find out after we physically die, so it is rather important to make certain on this side of that curtain. I recently purchased a copy of Nabeel Qureshi’s book, Seeking Allah, Finding Jesus1. Nabeel grew up devoted to God from his earliest childhood. The devotion to Allah and to Mohamed’s teachings of his Moslem family should put many Christians to shame. His was a home full of love—devoted parents and a wonderful sister. The Moslem ‘church family’ he belonged to, especially in his childhood years in Scotland, were devoted to one another in every way. During his first year in university in the USA, he met a friend, David Wood, a sincere Christ-follower, who simply demonstrated the love of Jesus to Nabeel. Over the course of three years, David patiently and painstakingly answered Nabeel’s challenges and questions concerning the deity of Christ. Ultimately, it was God’s pursuit of Nabeel that brought Nabeel home. It was an extraordinarily painful journey—for God and for Nabeel. Copyright restrictions prevent me from presenting chapters 51, 52 and 53 of his book in their entirety as I would have wished. Please consider these short excerpts, in part anyway, as a book review, then do yourself a favour and purchase a copy. The chapters I reference are titled, Time to Mourn, The Word speaks and Finding Jesus. TIME TO MOURN: Leaving a way of life, that has been your whole life, all your life, is not easy. Nabeel had reached the point in his journey where he knew he had to submit to the Lordship of Jesus Christ. The cost was going to be enormous. According to Moslem tradition and the teachings of the Quran Nabeel would lose his family, his friends and his community. Everything of personal worth would be gone. “I began pleading to God out loud, “Ya Allah, O God! Give me time to mourn. More time to mourn the upcoming loss of my family, more time to mourn the life I’ve always loved.” One evening Nabeel sought God’s comfort in two books; the Quran and the Bible. As he first flipped through the pages of the Quran, looking for verses of comfort, he came to the realization that there was nothing there for him. Nothing. He picked up the Bible, acknowledging to himself that he had never read it for personal guidance before. He opened his NIV study Bible (a gift from David) at the book of Matthew. Within minutes he found the following words: “Blessed are they that mourn for they shall be comforted.” Matthew 5:4 Nabeel wrote, “The words were like a current going through my dead heart, electrifying it once more. It was as if God had written those words in the Bible two-thousand years prior specifically with me in mind.” As one who had grown up Moslem, the idea of being blessed for mourning seemed beyond comprehension. “Why would He bless me? And for mourning, no less. Why?” He continued reading, “Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness.” Not ‘blessed are the righteous’. We can hunger and thirst for righteousness but never attain it, yet God says He will bless us anyway? Who is this God who loves us so much, even in our failures? “Tears flowed from my eyes once more, but now they were tears of joy. I knew that what I held in my hands was life itself. This was truly God’s Word, and it was as if I was meeting Him for the first time.” As he continued reading, Nabeel felt that if he put the Bible down his heart would literally stop beating, “perhaps implode”. Nabeel suggests that some might ask why he did not just go ahead and recite ‘the sinner’s prayer’? He had never heard of the Sinner’s Prayer. All he knew was that he loved the God of the Bible. THE WORD SPEAKS: Some days later he came to Matthew 10:32-33 “Whoever acknowledges me before others, I will also acknowledge before my Father in Heaven. But whoever disowns me before others, I will disown before my Father in Heaven.” His heart sank. He had not even acknowledged Jesus to Jesus, let alone to others. But to acknowledge Jesus meant destroying his family. Could God really charge him to do such a thing? “As if the living word of the Bible were in conversation with me, Jesus began responding to my heart, verse by verse.” “Do not suppose that I have come to bring peace to the earth. I did not come to bring peace, but a sword. column1: Why is Keanu Reeves so great?
column3: Right now, all we ought to do is to make a movie out of Keanu Reeves’s life, and that’s it; the film will go on to win a few Oscars. But then again, who can portray the role of Keanu Reeves better than Keanu Reeves? Over time, only one man could perfectly portray the role of leading a humble person: Keanu Reeves. The actor has always been an introvert who doesn’t often talk about his life or himself. A string of events made him who he is now, but his journey was never easy. He came a long way to get to where he is right now.He is a survivor: Grief, agony, and tragic losses have always circled his life from a very young age. He has suffered grievous losses and prolonged grief and misery throughout his life. However, he has always received full support from the Americans and his existing fans along with the Hollywood movie-lovers. He has fought through the dark alley of emotions and came out victorious. Nobody knows him better than he does. The most humbled Hollywood actor: Only his God knows what he has faced over the years; his life is more like a tragic film in which every twist and turn comes with some teachings for the public. His life is more like a long-going motion picture with terrible climaxes, which changes his course of energy over time. The man has suffered a lot and has always been kind and humble while holding the ground. Money, fame, and international name never took the best out of him. Several milestones define him: He is still a well-renowned actor and has admirable grace and restraint every time he shares his story. There have been times when he was completely hopeless and did not know what to do. He felt like he was in a never-ending pain, especially with the incredible misfortunes that befell him. However, these misfortunes were just one part of the picture. His whole story is filled with several milestones, and each of these milestones is filled with pain and intense grief.More than just a mere actor: Keanu Reeves has seen ups and downs in his career, but it took a winding path to get his success. He was his only audience for a long time; he has always been his biggest critic and greatest supporter. The actor always found solace in his own company, being an introvert, but something changed. Time and situation changed him completely, and he was different. He is not a celebrity or just not an actor, and that was something that the world noticed later. The root of Keanu Reeves: Right now, the whole world acknowledges him for what he is - a real fighter, a complete humanitarian; even after going through so much pain and agony, he is still a humble man. Keanu Reeves first cried in Beirut, Lebanon, on September 2, 1964; he is of English-Hawaiian descent, so he is of mixed race. However, it might have helped him to be more into the creative side and earn the fame and name which he always deserved. Right now, the whole world acknowledges him for what he is - a real fighter, a complete humanitarian; even after going through so much pain and agony, he is still a humble man. His start was rough: However, the childhood of Keanu Reeves was not an easy journey for him. Keanu Reeves was born in a broken family. His father, Samuel Reeves, spent half of his life behind bars for dealing with heroin. In short, before becoming a heartthrob for many girls and qualifying as an action movie hero, the actor did not have a bed of roses to sleep on at the end of the day. So, Keanu Reeves’ starting was not a good one. A family of three: Keanu Reeves has a biological sister from his biological father. However, he never spent much time with his father, so maybe that was also a reason behind his dad’s little influence on his upbringing. As his father was gone, he and his family were left to tend to themselves; it was when Keanu Reeves was just three years old. Now they were a family of three - he, his sister, and his mother. A different impact on him: First, the family moved from Lebanon to Sydney to start a new life. However, things weren’t fruitful for the family, so they shifted to New York. In short, Keanu Reeves moved through three continents in his childhood. It hugely impacted him from a very young age, not being able to see his father ever and being in stranger lands with his mother and only little sister to tend to in the upcoming life. The childhood of the actor: Keanu Reeves’s mom, Patricia Reeves, was a single mother as she was left to take care of the little boy Keanu and his sister Kim alone. Now things were not so easy for her; she was finding it difficult to make ends meet with two more mouths to feed. Although she showed that she worked as a costume designer, reportedly, she was working as a stripper to get some extra income. Keanu was too young to go out to work. So, the whole pressure was on Patricia Reeves. The only breadwinner for the family: Staying in New York is expensive, and she needs to beat through the worst times by doing something which can at least save her and her two children. Keeping the testing times in mind then, Patricia was the only breadwinner in the family. She was always looking to get along with the days. Although Keanu Reeves started working at nine, that was more out of passion than being a breadwinner for the family.A huge impact on his boyhood: In short, Keanu Reeves grew up in a very simplistic life and went to bed cold and without food, maybe sometimes in his early childhood. However, the family of three was always moving from one place to another, and eventually, the initial family of three settled down in Toronto. Throughout this time, Keanu Reeves’s mother had numerous relationships and remarried three times. It was a huge deal for Reeves as the boyhood of Keanu crossed through three stepfathers. A very introverted boy: His mother married over a very short time, so Keanu Reeves got introduced to too many families within a short span. This impact was deep on him as he found himself having trusting issues. Thanks to his mother’s husband, Keanu Reeves got to add more siblings to his list of extended family members. But, physically and mentally, he was a very quiet boy. As a teenager, Keanu Reeves struggled with dyslexia, and studying was difficult for him. He dropped out of school: This difficulty with learning was not so much cared for by his mother, so suppressive aggression was also inside him. Neither his school authorities nor his family could solve his trouble with dyslexia. Due to his learning inability and the added concerns of failure to express the issues, he grew a tendency to disobey the school authority. He could not describe his problem, and the rules were ridiculous for him in such cases, which forced him to leave the academy. He was never happy with his school life as things were not easy for him. In the words of Keanu Reeves: In his interview with a media outlet, Keanu Reeves specifically mentioned that “he did not have a traditional path because he changed four high schools,” so this unconventional path filled this whole education period with obstacles for him. He could not keep up with the academy administrations, who did not understand his shortcomings. As a result, Keanu Reeves never finished high school. Usually, it is expected for every celebrity to at least complete their schooling. But, it was very difficult for Keanu Reeves, so he left his high school without graduating. Always a fighter: This situation was a huge disadvantage for anyone in the United States of America to overcome. However, Keanu Reeves turned his biggest drawback into his greatest challenge; even though he had dyslexia, his artistic abilities took the right shape and form. Keanu Reeves was always a fighter and kept his head down when he fought through every challenge. Surprisingly, Keanu Reeves exceeded the expectations of every authority figure who rejected him.More testing times for him ahead: However, God and destiny were waiting to shove him towards the biggest trials and challenges in his life. These challenges molded his character into the compassionate person she is right now. Hollywood’s glitz and glamor never touched him completely; the pain and struggle were so continuous that being in the public eye never made him feel special. The success never got into his head, as he was subjected to much harder situations in the future. His acting skill: Keanu Reeves might not be educationally qualified, but he always knew he had that artistic tint within him. Keanu always wanted to become an actor when he was just a boy. Although the actor was never a great student at school and failed to make his teachers understand his potential, Reeves always harbored a keen interest in acting. He knew deep within that acting was one of his knacks. He always loved to portray characters in front of the camera. He always loved playing Hockey: However, even though acting was his first love, he also showed interest in sports. This specific sport always had a special place in his heart; he played numerous Hockey matches and was an outstanding goalie. However, destiny had something else stored for him - his sports career came to a tumultuous halt after he injured his knee in one of the matches. However, the injury was severe, and it stopped him from playing completely. He pursued his first love: The knee injury always played tricks on him, and even to this day, his fans can see that he faced troubles on the set of John Wick. Moreover, age is a factor, and Jock Wick is an action movie, so combined with both, he still suffers from the consequences of the knee injury he received in his boyhood. However, since he was thrown out of the sports world by destiny, it allowed him to pursue his first love - Acting. He is an A-listed actor: Supposedly it was written in the planets and stars that Keanu Reeves would rise to fame and gain international popularity through the entertainment world. Instead, the knee jury became a blessing for him as he went on to become an A-list actor who took Hollywood by storm. Today Keanu Reeves is an international actor known for the hit movie franchise The Matrix. However, Keanu Reeves started his journey as an actor at a very young age.He started as a theater artist: He got involved with acting when he was just nine years old. The stage called him, and he played several roles in the theater before considering facing the camera. The theater drama always fascinated him as it helped him grow as an actor before he became a superstar. He was good as an actor and even got cast for the position of Mercutio in Shakespeare’s classic Romeo and Juliet when he was just fifteen years old. Starting in commercials: His looks and acting skills did earn him some advertisements. In the late 1980s, Keanu Reeves appeared in several commercials, including one for Coca-Cola. His looks and youth with a model figure were enough for the casting directors to find him eligible for placing him in their advertisements. These initial experiences also helped him gain some pennies as financial constraints were a big issue for him from the tender age of three. Moving to Los Angeles: However, soon his work in commercials was taken notice by various directors and producers. He made his first movie appearance in One Step Away, which was released in 1985. However, it just gave him the chance to be introduced to the world as a new face, but he couldn’t quite find his place as an actor until he decided to move to Los Angeles. After all, he wanted to pursue acting seriously, so he needed to be in the hub of the entertainment world. Keanu Reeves has a mentor: Keanu Reeves was in a new city in his early twenties with little to no savings. He had big plans, and he was ready to execute his plans. Keanu Reeves got the support of his extended family as the young actor was determined to win over the entertainment world. Paul Aaron was Keanu Reeves’ first stepfather, and he was also a stage and film director. Keanu Reeves always found his first stepfather as his mentor, and Paul Aaron helped him during his crucial time by finding him a suitable manager. Got assistance as an actor: Paul Aaron and Patricia Reeves were married only for a year; however, he had a lasting impact on young Keanu Reeves that year. The young actor always maintained a close connection with his first stepfather, and he helped the actor to get roles in theater and various dramas in his initial years of life. Landing in the City of Angels, he found Paul Aaron was his first mentor, and after assigning Keanu to the most suitable manager, the roles soon started to pile up.Being cast as a teenager: Keanu Reeves had a baby face, so as an actor, he became recognizable for playing teenagers on screen. He repeatedly got the same roles, including being cast as a rambunctious or clumsy boy driven by roaring hormones. Now, the character was rather close to his real life. Keanu Reeves was a rambunctious boy in high school, so playing those roles made him a hit actor in the American household. However, it did not satisfy his artistic thirst as he wanted to do more on screen. The thirst of an artist: Keanu Reeves was an artist with an experience in theater, and he knew what he wanted from the acting world. He did not deny the roles as money was a factor, and these roles were easy for him to play, keeping his personal history in front of him. Keanu Reeves has always been humble and took most opportunities that the entertainment life threw at him. But he was always focused on his goal to be a versatile actor. More than a superstar, Keanu Reeves wanted to show his artistic side by acting in meaningful roles. The first breakthrough movie: He always wanted to explore as an actor and do more by pushing his acting skills. During the 1990s, he slowly and steadily began to break out of his stereotypes. He started to step outside his typecasted teenage roles. He was determined, and with that determination, he left a huge impression with his next movie, Point Break, which was released in 1991. In the movie Point Break, his co-star was Patrick Swayze. However, the movie gave him national recognition, and in 1992, he received the MTV Movie Award for the Most Desirable Male. The humble heartthrob in the U.S: Keanu Reeves was climbing the ladder of success and getting closer to the dreams and goals he had always wanted to fulfill. It took time, but the actor earned recognition year by year as one of the most sought-after actors. His charming looks and humble personality filled with warmth and kindness are praised by fellows in Hollywood. He became a household heartthrob man in America. A very private person: Women worldwide went into a whole craze for his fabulous chocolate-boy good looks and boyish charm. Keanu Reeves had always been a private person, so the media knew little about his love life as he was always very secretive about his personal life. Keanu Reeves was always clever enough to keep his life a secret and knew the tricks well. He was never a typical celebrity who would boast about the attention he was receiving due to his success in the entertainment world; rather, he gave the paparazzi a very hard time finding news related to his personal life. Kept off the intoxication: When Keanu Reeves was asked why he remained so grounded, he said that he always kept the consumption of intoxicants to a minimum. He has gone through the worst in the initial days of his life, so he did not allow himself to be gobbled up by the cold whirlpool of celebrity vices. Afterall, his biological father has gone through legal trouble due to dealing with illegal substances. Keanu Reeves and his sister had to face the immediate aftermath of the illegal trading of their biological father.Life always taught him a lesson: He never saw his daddy again until he was thirteen years old, and that was it. Supposedly at that time, his biological father had completed his prison sentence. It is true due to his stressful past and tumultuous life, and he did get into drug addiction. He used certain chemical substances to abuse himself when he started. But, whenever he tried to cross the line, life was always there to teach him lessons and remind him about his roots. He was as sober as drinking water: Then his late-best friend and colleague River Phoenix died from an accidental overdose. This loss of a close confidant mentally affected him and led Keanu Reeves, the person, to stand against drug abuse. Keanu Reeves completely recovered from his addiction and has been sober for three decades. He does drink occasionally but never gets drunk enough to lose his head. His first overseas recognition: 1994 marked a turning point in Keanu Reeves’ career when he got the lead role in the hit movie Speed, alongside his then-love interest Sandra Bullock. It was an off-beat role for the young actor, and the action-packed masterpiece soon earned the audience’s appreciation and became a worldwide hit. Keanu Reeves became much more conscious about his life and maintained a routine of making good choices. The romantic linkup: Keanu Reeves became an internationally recognized Hollywood actor just through this movie. However, the actor was not stopping; he soon gained his deserved place and recognition. All these years, he was desired by American women, but with Speed, he became a heartthrob overseas. However, rumors started to spread that Sandra Bullock and Keanu Reeves were seeing each other. Paparazzi were at it: Hollywood media got attached to this couple then and repeatedly claimed that Keanu Reeves and Sandra Bullock were dating. However, Reeves denied all the claims and said he and Sandra Bullock are just very good friends. Now that was something that the media did not take it. Even though Keanu Reeves was doing everything to hide his relationship, the paparazzi could get information through close sources of these actors.The rumors were true: The Hollywood tabloids repeatedly said that the relationship of Keanu Reeves with Sandra Bullock was way beyond friendly terms. However, the duo kept hiding their relationship from the public, especially from the media. But, the paparazzi were hell-bent on finding the truth, and towards the end of 2011, the rumors about their relationship were more intense than ever. The media reported that the then-couple went on several dates, although they could not take any snaps, thanks to Keanu Reeves’s fierce privacy policy. He did not return in the sequel: However, fans confirmed that Keanu Reeves and Sandra Bullock were dating privately. The duo never acknowledged their relationship or went publicly beyond their onscreen romance. Even though everybody knew about the obvious chemistry between them, they kept it hidden until they parted ways. Until now, the media claims that Sandra and Keanu were a thing back then. Ironically, Keanu Reeves refused to play the sequel to the movie Speed, and fans realized that was not a coincidence. Going back to the start: The media also confirmed that the duo was in a relationship but now has broken up and does not prefer to share onscreen space anymore. It was made obvious to all of them. However, the actor was determined to remove the rumor, which was difficult for him. ​​Keanu Reeves decided to return to the drawing board. His breakup with Sandra Bullock and too much media attention were causing him to get overwhelmed. So, he re-entered the world of theater, and once again, by playing the role of Hamlet, he set the stage on fire. The audience once again applauded him: He received outstanding appraisals for his role as Hamlet from the audience and the theater experts. Critics appreciated his role as a young Hamlet and even said that Keanu Reeves interpreted the role well because he was himself the Hamlet in real life. The audience was excited and awestruck by his acting skills and understood that the actor in Keanu was never gone, or at least the limelight could never suck it out of him. He made a new comeback: Shortly after the success of Hamlet, Keanu Reeves returned to the big screen once more, but this time, he looked much more refreshed, and his career again got a boost as he started to appear in high-budget movies such as Walk in the Clouds and Chain Reaction. At that time, Keanu Reeves looked like a graceful prince, and with his real-life experiences, he could unite his innocence and angst and apply it to his character. It was a breakthrough performance in his career as he fell in the eyes of the directors and producers, who understood that he was also into method acting. Second romantic linkup: During this time, he was again linked with the actress Charlize Theron. Reeves became close with Charlize Theron, and the tabloids caught them getting too cuddly in public several times. This time Keanu Reeves was not hiding his relationship with Charlize Theron and was completely engaged in PDA. However, the couple never openly acknowledged their relationship. Even after parting, both kept tight-lipped regarding any romantic bond outside the movie sets. Nevertheless, the future events in his life would earn him the crown of being the Saddest Guy in Hollywood.He got his biggest career milestone: 1999 was when Keanu Reeves broke all records and created another milestone. Keanu’s career skyrocketed when he got the lead role in The Matrix, a classic action blockbuster movie. It was an action-packed movie, and he needed to be physically active and spontaneous enough to do the role. The movie was a challenge to him, and Reeves took up the challenge and successfully mastered an extremely physically demanding position. Nevertheless, he did it, he successfully played the role of Neo in the first installment, and it gained him worldwide appraisal. Got internationally recognized: According to estimates, the first installment added more than thirty million dollars to his bank account. Nevertheless, he reprised his role as Neo in two subsequent sequels of the Matrix franchise. The most iconic factor was that, at the casting, Keanu Reeves was selected through audition over other Hollywood A-listers such as Leonardo di Caprio, Will Smith, and Brad Pitt. He was a super hit actor who received international recognition, fame, name, and popularity through the Matrix franchise, just like Johnny Depp received from Pirates of the Caribbean. The first shock of his life: However, time always tested Keanu Reeves at different stages of his life. Already ominous clouds were gathering over Keanu Reeves’s life. The first personal shock came to him after his sister Kim Reeves was diagnosed with leukemia in 1992. That was ground-breaking news for him. He donated more than a quarter of his earnings to treat his sister. He did everything he could to save his sister, who is thankfully still alive and grateful to him. A huge philanthropist: However, Keanu Reeves again proved he is a private person; this news was not made public. The actor made sure the paparazzi did not get a hint of his sister’s disease. He was too stressed out to receive any extra media attention then. He wanted to keep his family out of the media limelight and the harsh scrutiny they might have faced during that time. The public was unaware of the actual reason, but Keanu Reeves donated a lot of money to cancer charities and organizations. He even opened a private charitable foundation and still runs it. In the words of the humble actor: But then again, Keanu Reeves has proved humble and modest and does not attach his name to the foundation. “I have a personal foundation that’s been operating for five or six years, enabling aiding a couple of children’s hospitals and cancer research. I don’t like to connect my name to it; I just let the foundation do what it does,” he said back in 2009 to a media outlet. His love of life: It was during the period of filming The Matrix that his path crossed with a woman that turned his life upside down. He met a young lady who would completely make him a changed man. Her name was Jennifer Syme, and she was the first woman who made Keanu Reeves take anyone seriously. At that time, Jennifer Syme worked as the famous director David Lynch’s assistant. She was not publicly renowned but known in the film world for connections with the director.He made it official with her: Jennifer Syme used to attend various official film parties as David Lynch’s assistant. However, the two met at a record label party in the City of Angels and hit it off instantly. They soon started dating, and before they could think, Keanu Reeves was serious about her. He wanted to make her official and authenticate his relationship with Jennifer Syme. She was the first girl to appear publicly as Keanu Reeves’s official girlfriend. They were ready to start a family: All this while Keanu Reeves hid his previous relationships, but with Jennifer Syme, he went open and clear after a long while. However, Keanu Reeves was always serious about Jennifer Syme, and it became clear after a long while. She meant the world to him, and fans realized it after a long time. They hit it off instantly, and Jennifer Syme was pregnant a year into their relationship. Keanu Reeves was elated with the news as he was excited to be a father. However, the duo did not tie the knot but was prepared to welcome the baby. The tragic and agonizing incident: Jennifer Syme and Keanu Reeves moved in together and eagerly awaited the baby’s arrival. However, there were certain complications in Jennifer’s pregnancy. Nonetheless, the day of baby delivery came too soon. The baby girl was born prematurely in the eighth month and was too shocking and dangerous. Unfortunately, there was nothing the medics could do to save the infant girl. The baby girl was in the world for a couple of hours before she left Reeves and Syme forever. The loss affected their relationship: It was the most painful factor for the couple. The child's devastated parents named her Ava Archer Syme-Reeves and dedicated a grave to her. However, something was not the same anymore; the grief of losing a child was unbearable for the couple. The relationship between the actor and his girlfriend, Jennifer Syme, started to deteriorate. They could not handle the immense grief as it was difficult to justify the loss. Gradually they drifted away, but they did keep in touch occasionally. A new shocking tragedy was on the way: Keanu Reeves never officially said he had broken up with Jennifer Syme, as that was never his intention. They wanted to take a break and focus on personal time; they wanted to heal from the pain rather than heal together. However, Keanu Reeves never got the chance to heal as another shocking wound was on his way. Once, she was coming back from a house party on the morning of April 2, 2001. A fatal accident and then death: Jennifer Syme was driving herself, and unfortunately, Syme lost control of her vehicle and crashed into a row of parked automobiles in Los Angeles. The accident was fatal, and she died instantly. Her body was placed next to their late infant child in Westwood Village Memorial Park Cemetery in Los Angeles. Keanu Reeves was present on the day of her funeral. Destroyed him: Some experts later said Jennifer Syme was never in the mental state to drive, especially after losing her child. This whole set of events was enough to destroy him completely. His life turned upside down, and he was no longer the same person. He lost his first child and then his love of life; he was destroyed; the intense loss broke Keanu Reeves’s heart into tiny pieces. These tragic losses in his life completely shattered him.Started to move out of the industry: He was supposed to start filming the sequel of The Matrix but had to take some time to grieve. He has always been committed to his work, so he finished the Matrix movies' sequels and received worldwide fame and critical acclaim through his sequels but, internally, he was completely a broken man. However, after he completed The Matrix contract, he did not sign for any more sequels. He couldn't continue his work because his pain was too much for him. Went through the grieving process: Although he never said anything openly, as he was more into suffering alone, he was never too open about his private life. He wanted to go through his grieving process and needed ample time to heal internally. However, these tragic events made him retreat from the limelight completely and blend into his privacy even more and more. “Much of my gratitude for life has come through loss. Life is precious. It’s valuable.” Keanu Reeves said in an interview for a media tabloid back in 2006. In the words of Keanu Reeves: All these tragic events and the actor’s life was never the same. It was tough for him to focus on his work, passion, and goal. He lost hope for a while and wanted to give himself more time as a human being who could cherish every moment of their valuable life. “Grief changes shape, but it never ends,” Keanu Reeves said in an interview in 2006. “All you can do is hope that time will transform grief and, instead of feeling ache and mess, you will be together again in remembrance, that there will be ease and contentment there, not just loss.” Back to the ordinary world: It was a healing process that Keanu Reeves went through, and he took a complete break from the film industry for at least a decade. Keanu Reeves became an ordinary citizen of America who gave up on all the pleasures of life. He was nowhere to be found for years because the actor deliberately took a long break from the spotlight. The actor wanted to blend into the public and get lost in it. He was not the superstar Keanu Reeves; he was the simple guy Keanu, who started his life in the theater world. He was spotted everywhere: Sooner than later, people started spotting Keanu Reeves in all sorts of random places in public — he was spotted and snapped by his fans at grocery stores, subway stations, trains, and various other public places. He was sitting along with the crowd, traveling with them, eating amongst them, reading newspapers amongst them, just as a normal citizen of America did every day. Fans became concerned about him: Soon, he became a motivation for the public around him, who was concerned with his mental health. Fans became concerned with his well-being and started posting various updates on him on social media. It was evident that Keanu Reeves was clinically depressed and under treatment, but whenever somebody talked to him, he kept that down-to-earth grace he had always possessed. Grief might have paused him for a while, but it did not make him rough towards life. They were with the actor: He became a stellar example for the public and movie lovers worldwide. People who did not prefer him as an actor loved him as a human being, especially by seeing him so touched and moved by the loss of his girlfriend and child. Instead of mocking or ignoring him, his fans worldwide wanted to give him some love and support. They wanted to show him that they were with him in his fight against depression. The people around America started sharing stories about their lovely encounters with the actor.Lovely encounters were heartwarming: They broadcasted his picture on social media and requested others to be soft and kind towards him. The world went from sympathizing with him to looking up to him as a model figure who values love and relationship to a deeper extent. Many of the people Keanu Reeves met in his regular encounters said kind and supportive words to him. Everyone knew he was struggling, ready to stretch their warm hands over his shoulder. Some of the encounters shared by his fans were overwhelming and heartwarming. Ground-to-the-earth person: Various people discussed their experiences conversing with him, and they all agreed that Keanu Reeves was sweet, polite, and genuinely good. Some of them even said that even though he was suffering from pain, he listened to their troubles and issues with patience. The actor soon became a heartthrob amongst the public. Nobody from Hollywood has been so close to the public, and Keanu Reeves made it happen; he reached out to every corner of America. Keanu Reeves's grief managed him to avoid that typical Hollywood superstar arrogance. Fans were always supportive of him: People came in close contact with him and realized that successful Hollywood stars could also be kind, soft, and genuine. His fans soon dubbed him to be “the world’s crush.” He was soon a household name for his immensely grounding gesture and grace. Keanu Reeves stayed away from the spotlight for a long time, and the media left him alone as he wanted to be left alone.
