I mean imagine that one person who got viral was a chai wala.. Have you ever seen a burgerwala getting that kinda love..Even with our proclaimed arch enemy.. they thought the tea was fantastic.. 5) Older people always telling the younguns about Hamarey Zamaney Mein (In our times) Variant 1 - 60s-70s people - In our times, petrol was this.. dollar was this.. things were so orderly… PIA was this this.. Hippies were this.. we were on the world map as this emerging progressive force.. Mostly this variant isby the parents who want to tell their kids that they too were cool in their time.. and the Pakistan that you know today is just a speck of what it was..The other parent variant is that we came from humble backgrounds, but you kids are so privileged today.Variant 2: 70s and 80s.. - We fought through Zia’s dictatorship.. while he shut down all that was song music and dance.. we faced sticks and beatings. 1) Parents - What do you kids know about what personal sacrifice is.. 2) Parents (2) - We did what we could - what changed - people went from bad to worse (despondent type - nothing can change) Variant X - 80–90s kids reminscing about Imran Khan (home grown casonova), music in the 90s.. and of course the World CupThat one world cup win - made politics a game of cricket puns forever.. 6) Hukka Shukka: Before there was a ban, both men and women loved to partake in the sharing the sheesha/huka craze..woman 1: What does your kid do? (for people asking for a rishta/marriage) woman 2: Jee, he is quite creative, artist infact… He makes these amazing air patterns.. Meanwhile kid at some place, makes smoke rings with the hookah..Of course, women/men in the villages couldn’t care less what these city dwellers do with their flavored ones, they like to partake in the real deal7) Putting Ghee/Oil in everything - Every handi/curry you name it, it is there.. and not just small amounts..If there was a place, that men and women from the country would be interested in.. it would be called the Gheespot (Sorry children) 8) Overly emotional about cricketAfter Champions Trophy (at airport) to receive crowd.Or during loss (Did you know during the 1996 WC, when Pakistan lost to India, people allegedly kidnapped Wasim Akram’s father!)9) Coming on Live TV.. column1: What if a narcissist wants you to do something with them and you say no?
column3: Marlene Matlock, B.S., M.S., Married to Covert Malignant NPD for 47 years; NPD Writer on Quora for NPD/Child Custody with 3.6 million readers You must understand that the Narcissist is emotional stunted from damage in their childhood between the ages of 2–7 years when they are developing their personality. Their Emotional Intelligence is of an eight (8) year old. So if you tell any eight (8) year old “No” how are they going to act? The Narcissist will pout, have an attitude, disrespectful, rude, dismissive of your feelings, frustrated, angry and if it is something that is real important to them they will give you a rage. Now a rage is just like a two year old temper tantrum adult style and can be very terrifying to go through. You must understand a Narcissist is someone you should not be with. They are considered a toxic person all over the world. Trust me I was married 47 years to a Covert Malignant NPD and he destroyed me deep down to my soul leaving me a shell of a person walking away with a wry smile that he finally broke my spirit. They are not worth being with. Saying “NO” to a Narcissist can be perceived to them as a criticism and they do not do well with this. However, this does not mean you should do something just because he says it. You have to set up your boundaries. They want you to comply 100% and be obedient to do what they say. This is why Narcissists are not a good person to be in a relationship. They will never change or get well enough to be a warm, mentally healthy adult who you want in your life. There was one NPD that groomed a young woman who never had a boyfriend before and forced her to perform sexual acts she was not comfortable with but raged if she did not comply. Basically he groomed her to be his sexual object with no attention and no love. Trust me I’ve seen it happen because if you are with a NPD they trap and control you. LIFE OF A NARCISSIST Narcissism is a mental disorder of their thinking and behaviors which often begins in childhood but does not manifest symptoms till the early adulthood of twenties. NARCISSIST’S CHILDHOOD Narcissism can often begin its development in early childhood as the result of living with a Narcissistic parent(s) or caretaker. The child was damaged between the ages of 2–7 when they are developing their personality. As a child they are most likely treated to abuse/neglect, abandonment or overindulgence when very young, people who develop NPD fail to form a core sense of self or empathy. Narcissists do not establish emotionally mature and stable identities, self-esteem, and feelings of compassion for others. Their fundamental psycho-emotional emptiness leads them to continuously seek validation externally rather than from within. Their parasitic need for validation from others exacerbates their lack of empathy, leading to highly manipulative and abusive behavior to feed their endless need for attention, admiration, power, superiority and control. NARCISSIST’S EARLY ADULTHOOD As the NPD reaches early adulthood around their early twenties, they develop an unstable identity with a lack of self-esteem with low empathy. This results in the NPD being pathological or manipulative, exploitative, abusive personality that creates insidious devastation. People with NPD are exceptionally skilled abusers with a kind of technique that makes their abuse particularly destructive. RELATIONSHIP WITH A NARCISSIST They are incapable of ever loving you or their children. They are incapable of ever caring about you or even their children. They are incapable of ever caring about your feelings or their children’s feelings. They lack Emotional Empathy from their childhood. Those who are in a relationship with a NPD are familiar with Narcissists knowing too well their emotionally, psychologically, financial and often physically and sexual abusive behaviors which surface day to day, hour to hour and minute by minute. For those on the receiving end, people with NPD often seem monstrous and unrelenting. They cause extraordinary trauma, particularly in the lives of those closest to them all done behind closed doors so no witnesses will see what, with little to no remorse but instead the belief that their behavior is justified. OVERT VS. COVERT Overt Narcissists are often publicly charismatic, making their family’s abusive experience invisible to others. Covert Narcissists are expert at keeping their pathology hidden in the shadows, often presenting themselves as devoted family member or wronged victims with outsiders unaware of their morally bankrupt behavior at behind closed doors. NPD WITHHOLD EMOTIONAL EMPATHY Many people say a NPD is incapable of showing emotional empathy. A lack of empathy is often considered to be one of the distinctive features of narcissism. A Lack of Emotional Empathy is believed coming from their childhood when they were developing their personality between the ages of 2–7 years. It has been said that a Narcissist’s are INCAPABLE of ever:LOVING ANYONE in their life including their children.CARING ABOUT ANYONE in their life including their children.CARING ABOUT ANYONE’S FEELINGS including their children’s feelings.However, research has shown that it is not entirely true because studies have discovered that a NPD is UNWILLING to recognize or identify with the feelings and needs of others. Some people may consciously or unconsciously be motivated to withhold an empathetic response to control a partner or child, or they may exploit their understanding of a person’s or child’s emotional state to manipulate them or to gain power. Using their empathy manipulatively, for example, people with narcissistic pathology know how to evoke insecurity in their partners & children and provoke attachment anxiety. PATHOLOGICAL LIAR A pathological liar is somebody who lies without effort, someone for whom telling a lie comes more naturally than telling the truth. It can also result from low self-esteem or anxiety. Experts seem to think that extreme lying could be related to the combination of a need to impress and a tendency towards impulsive behavior. It is unknown why people do this, but compulsive lying often occurs in people with personality disorders, such as narcissism. Pathological lying can also be rooted in childhood trauma, as these individuals may have been raised by very strict parents who did not accept who they were. Therefore, the child had to create a persona as a coping mechanism to avoid punishment and vulnerability. While most children and teenagers outgrow normal lying, which is considered a normal part of development, pathological liars do not. They do not seem to be bothered by lying to someone. They do not appear to lie to the public but behind closed doors. They lie in order to avoid getting in trouble. Sometimes they lie for no reason. It does not make sense and if you approach them saying they have lied be prepared for a hideous Narcissistic Rage to throw you off that they are lying. Anxiety and a deep-seated fear of rejection is always present in a NPD. It’s when they cannot handle the truth or they cannot handle presenting the truth or the consequences, they can quickly relieve their anxiety with lies as if believed. Pathological lying is a problem that does not get better over time and certainly does not just go away. Traits of a Pathological Liar:Believe their own liesTell detailed and dramatic lies, which have no clear benefitTell lies when they do not even need to lie.Don’t usually show common body language associated with lying, such as avoidance of eye contactPortray themselves as victims or heroesThey will continue to lie even when confronted with evidence.For them, it is easier to tell a lie than to tell the truth.They will go into a court of law and stare into the eyes of the judge and lie just so they can get custody of the children to get back at their spouse.A pathological liar, often also called a compulsive liar, will lie habitually, so much so that lying has become second nature.Lying is a part of the liar’s everyday life to the point where their whole existence is a fabrication.A pathological liar will lie for no apparent reason.Pathological liars lack empathy, remorse and often have no sense of the consequences of their lies on other people’s feelings.Pathological liar believes they are smarter than everyone and will never be found out.Will go into a court of law looking the judge right in the eye and telling pathological lies to the judge to get what they want done.Guilt, shame, regret or consequences does not seem to affect the liar.NARCISSIST’S ADDICTIVE NEEDS Narcissism is all about illusion, chaos and fog of confusion with total mind f*ckery so they can abuse you. The only reason you are in their life is to get their needs met by using you. You must understand you mean NOTHING to your NPD. He conned you from Day One. The Narcissist’s goal in life is to tangle you up into their convoluted web of lies, deceit and abuse to obtain their Addictive Needs by having POWER over you; SUPERIORITY over you and CONTROL over you so they can get enough confidence to go into the public wearing their “Mask of Perfection” so they can get their Ultimate Addictive Needs which are ADMIRATION and ADORATION from the public. You see despite their arrogance, they are riddled with insecurities, unworthiness, fear, anger. They try to cover their feelings up by abusing you, lying to you, having affairs, manipulating you. It has absolutely nothing to do with you. Your NPD was not okay long before you showed up in his life. NARCISSISTIC SUPPLY Narcissistic Supply is a pathological or excessive need for POWER, SUPERIORITY AND CONTROL over their victims that does not take into account the feelings, opinions or preferences of tbem. It is important to understand “Narcissistic Supply” are not derogatory terms directed toward the victim. The psychology world has used theses terms for years to describe how a NPD uses a person. It is not a put down or a reflection of who the victim is or blaming the victim in any way. NARCISSISTIC ABUSE Narcissists don’t want an honest and loving relationship, they want admiration and adoration. They want blind loyalty and unconditional acceptance, no matter what they do. If you disagree with them or go against them in any way, to them, this is the deepest betrayal and this will never go unpunished. Narcissists are vengeful and spiteful. Narcissists are controlling, superior to others, manipulative bullies who chronically lie, degrade, devalue, exploit, disrespect and abuse others all done behind closed doors to maintain the image of being a perfect person to the outside world. As I’ve explained above, chronic trauma and stress physically causes the victim to forget things easily and finds it difficult to learn new things; depressed and lacks self-care; increased anxiety and mood disorders and not consciously aware of the abuse. There is a fog of confusion, prolific lying, gaslighting, blaming you, constant chaos, question themselves while the Narcissist takes no responsibility. Narcissistic abuse acts like traumatic stress and can lead to post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) or the more severe form, Complex PTSD, Stress-Related Illnesses, Anxiety Disorders, Depression and Trauma Bonding. These are life damages a Narcissist does to their victims. And yet, there are no criminal offenses in the USA for their behaviors. As I’ve explained trauma and constant stress causes the victim to forget things easily and finds it difficult to learn new stuff; depressed and present with a lack of self-care; increased anxiety and mood disorders and not consciously aware of the abuse. These are the things that physically happen to a Narcissist’s victim. There is a fog of confusion, prolific lying, gaslighting, blaming you, constant chaos, question themselves believing the Narcissist While they take no responsibility. NARCISSIST’S TYPICAL ABUSE Narcissists have different personalities however their abusive behavior manifests in remarkably consistent ways, including the following ways:Calculated charm in public and appalling and abusive treatment of family members behind closed doors.Sudden often rages with a hurricane’s ferocity that will drop you to your knees which can be referred to as a “Two-year-old Temper Tantrum” adult-style.Pitting people, particularly their family members, against one another (e.g., divide and conquer) as a means of control and to deflect blame and accountability.Refusal to take responsibility and blames the victim instead.Projection of abusive behavior and selfish motives others.Shaming, mocking, baiting, and ridiculing (often presented as “teasing”) to gain an advantage and feel superior.Sudden often rages with a hurricane’s ferocity which will drop you to your knees.Endless demands for agreement and NPD admiration.Inability to share attention with others, even their children.Scapegoating a child or putting another child on a pedestal.Pathological lying, bragging, cheating with affairs, pornography and bullying.Gaslighting where NPD distorts your reality to control someone and makes you think you’re crazy.Entitled, arrogant abuse of those below them, such as employees, waitresses, clerks, and secretaries.Grandiose assertions of superiority, omnipotence, and perfection.Indifference, impatience, anger, and disassociation with/from others’ illness, loss, misfortune, and so on.Denial, often outrageous in the face of blatant truth.NARCISSIST’S AWARENESS OF THEIR ABUSE Although a victim may not consciously be aware of the abuse, a Narcissist definitely knows what they are doing. Narcissists are aware of their negative traits but typically they do not care because they believe they are above the law. They believe they have no desire to change who they are because they believe they are a perfect person. They wear the “Mask of Perfection” in front of the public to hide behind who they really are. Narcissists can stoop to any level to guard that image, often ending up emotionally — and sometimes physically — abusing their loved ones. A Narcissist will try to convince you, that your emotional responses to their abuse are the problem but in reality, it is the their abuse that is the problem. Victims who are constantly abused by Narcissists are forced to believe a distorted version of reality as they are constantly lied to and manipulated. UNKNOWN HIDDEN NARCISSISTIC ABUSE Those unfamiliar with NPD and narcissistic abuse typically find it incomprehensible. Typically this abuse will occur behind closed doors to maintain the Narcissist’s act of perfection in public. This is because the Narcissist’s lack of a moral compass is difficult to imagine without direct experience with it and because people with NPD generally work to present a picture of normalcy or even an ideal while wearing their “Mask of Perfection” life to outsiders. Even most therapists are unschooled in NPD except for psychiatrists because they are also medical doctors trained in personality disorders. This lack of knowledge damages those who live with narcissists, which nearly invariably leads to Post Traumstic Stress Disorder (PTSD) or Complex-PTSD (C-PTSD) and a host of other lasting emotional and health effects like stress-related illnesses like heart disease and anxiety. Other symptoms that show up in victims are depression, chronic stress-related illnesses, trauma bonding, brain damage. As a consequence, those harmed by Narcissistic abuse are further traumatized by the isolation from family and friends and self-doubt that comes with it. They are vulnerable to judgment and ill-conceived advice from outsiders who don’t understand and may encourage them to forgive, confront, reconcile with, or otherwise open themselves up to further and more destructive abuse. The Mayo Clinic research group believes that those with NPD actually believe that they're superior to others and have little regard for other people's feelings. Wearing this “Mask of Perfection” to the public shows ultra-confidence but behind it lies a very fragile self-esteem, vulnerable to the slightest criticism. PHYSICAL REACTIONS TO NARCISSISTIC ABUSE Research studies suggest that continuous traumatic stress to abuse can damage the brain cells that affects three major parts of the brain of their victims. It’s common knowledge these days that consistent emotional trauma over a long period of time can cause victims to develop both PTSD and C-PTSD. This is why anyone in a destructive relationship with a partner who cares little for the emotional well-being of their family should leave immediately, especially when children are involved. There is brain damage with long-term Narcissistic Abuse. Here is the damage done to the parts of the brain.HIPPOCAMPUS. First of all, Hippocampus stores the short-term memories in your brain before they get converted into long-term memory. Hence it decides how and when you learn new things. Continuous stress due to abuse can damage the brain cells in the hippocampus, making it gradually shrink in size. As a result, the person starts to forget things easily and finds it difficult to learn new stuff.PREFRONTAL CORTEX. Secondly, the Prefrontal Cortex is the region of the brain that is located right behind the eyes. This region controls attention, memory, decision-making, and planning. Just like the hippocampus, this region is observed to shrink in traumatic stress. People suffering from narcissistic abuse find it difficult to make decisions and tend to have a shorter attention span. They also tend to be depressed and present with a lack of self-care.AMYGDALA. This is the fear centre of the brain — gets activated every time you feel anxious or scared like the time a Narcissistic rages on you. It stores all the memories of the abuse and gets activated every time someone talks about it. Traumatic stress increases the size of the amygdala. This manifests as increased anxiety and mood disorders.NARCISSISTIC VICTIM SYNDROME Narcissistic Victim Syndrome is a set of symptoms that most partners experience due to ongoing abuse from Narcissistic partners. According to some of the symptoms one can experience suffering from Narcissistic Victim Syndrome may include: “Fog of confusion, anxiety, pacing, ‘loss of self’, panic attacks, angry outbursts, constant defeat with their criticisms, chronic crying, insomnia, weight gain or weight loss, obsessive thoughts, rapid heart rate, muscle aches, throwing up, getting sick, desiring death, possibly suicidal, no interest in previous interests or even loved ones, blaming self, second guessing self, may seem desperate and trying to reach for help, fear of Narcissist annihilating them.” Abuse endured by partners of a narcissist is often incredibly traumatic and greatly impacts one’s sense of self-worth and confidence. The sooner one recognizes these symptoms the sooner they can move on and get well. NPD are considered toxic people all over the world. As long as one thinks they are still in love with their NPD after understanding this information, they will end up having their NPD devastate them deep down to their soul and leave them a shell of a person. If you have children, your NPD will damage your children causing anxiety disorders, low self-esteem and incredible pain on into their adulthood. HOOVERING Once you are in a relationship with a NPD they believe they “own” you. They usually come back because their Narcissistic Supply Is running low or non-existent. They can come back to you anytime saying they really love you; saying they realize they have problems and will get therapy, and they really want to make a go of the relationship. All Hooverings are the NPD’s lies. They want to manipulate you back into their life to abuse and use you. There was a woman who was divorced for 36 years. Her NPD looked her up and told her he had changed and she was the one he truly loved. They were married two weeks and the mental and emotional abuse was so much worse. They will come back if their Narcissistic Supply is low or nonexistent. MY LIFE WITH A COVERT MALIGNANT NPD In my life, I was married to a Covert Malignant NPD (MNPD) for 47 years. Although the abuse is same in NPD and MNPD but with the Malignant NPD it is more pathological in their abuse. All my family and friends criticized and ostracized me because all they saw was his “Mask of Perfection.” I was isolated and very lonely because absolutely no one believed me, even my family and friends. No doctor, no nurse, no home health nurse, no pastor and no policeman or Social Workers understood and these are the ones who are mandated to report the NPD Abuse but sadly I learned it is only for children and the elderly. You are literally trapped and no where to go for help because no one recognizes NPD. We saw numerous therapist but no understanding. I was mentally, physically and emotionally exhausted beyond all understanding. In my life, I had no Quora, no internet; no NPD support websites; no You-Tube videos and no books and no articles. So after I saw a psychiatrist because I was severely depressed; Complex PTSD; Stress-Related Illnesses that affect my health even today; Severe Trauma Bonding and constantly crying. As a result of my experience, I developed a passion for educating people because I had no understanding. I educate people so they understand because I want no one to be devastated deep down to their soul and left with a shell of a person with no hope like my NPD did to me. Most often you are financially abused by your NPD just as well because they control the money and you have no access. CRIMINALIZING NPD Literally it is criminal what NPD do in their Narcissistic Abuse to their victims. Yet there are only three countries in the world that have criminalized the psychological and emotional abuse a victim endures. The countries that criminalize the Narcissist and their Mental & Emotional Abuse are France (2010); UK (2015); and Ireland (2018). The United States is so far behind in understanding this hidden mental disorder while their victims suffer so very much. I only hope the US understands the brutality a NPD does to their spouse, Significant Other and their children. FULL CUSTODY OF CHILDREN & NO VISITATION In our courts, Narcissists are getting full custody or co-parenting of an innocent child that will be damaged on into their adult life by their NPD. Narcissist’s will not be bothered in lying to the judge to get what they want because they are pathological liars. All the abuse by the NPD is done behind closed doors so no one sees the damage they do so they can remain appearing “Perfect” in the public eye. The NPD wants custody in order to have control over the Non-NPD Parent. They are jealous of the relationship between the non-NPD parent and the child so they will try to bad talk and destroy their relationship. Narcissists will not give the child the nurturing they need or the love or caring which results in the NPD’s lack of emotional empathy. Children grow up to have have anxiety disorders, low self-esteem and possibly turn into a NPD themselves. GENERATIONAL NARCISSISM Although the causes of NPD aren't well understood. inherited genetic defects are thought to be responsible for many cases of NPD. Contributing environmental factors may include: childhood abuse or neglect. Narcissistic personality disorders are a byproduct of certain childhood family environments. All children want their parents’ approval and attention. Children will adapt to their homes, and often the most productive and reasonable adaptation to negative home situations is to become a Narcissist but not all children in the family will become NPD. If a parent(s) is a Narcissist, the family will be exposed to the Narcissist’s emotional, mental, verbal and physical abuse which can cause Narcissism in some of the children. That child that develops into a NPD in turn develops his family causing Narcissism in that family, that creates Generational Narcissism. The Generational Narcissism continues from one generation to another costing the mental health community tremendous amounts of money because they are developing new Narcissists that literally destroy more and more people. The judicial system has typically given custody to the Narcissistic parent primarily due to the Narcissist’s pathological lying in the court room. The judicial system and attorneys need to be educated on the facts of a Narcissist. It is critically important for the non-NPD parent to maintain full custody with no visitation from the NPD. CONCLUSION Remember adult will eventually heal and be okay but your NPD is incapable of ever healing to be a normal mature, caring and loving human being. The person who is with a Narcissist did nothing wrong in this relationship so it is important to not give your Narcissist anymore time in your head. NPD are pathological liars so everything they criticized you about and told about you were all lies and just a reflection of who they believe they are. They are mentally disordered long before you showed up on the scene. And yes, with a great amount of effort you will eventually be able to heal. So basically I would tell you that if your Narcissist wants you to do something that you are not comfortable with then your Narcissist will probably get angry or rage, or possible react in any of the things I listed above. You need to set your boundaries but typically they will still try to cross it. This is why it is recommended to get out of this relationship as soon as possible. They are not worth it! They were not okay long before you showed up on the scene. Get out and stay out!!

column1: Why in India there is a very few startups in Medical device industry?
column3: I am a FDA medical device Investigator and I have inspected hundreds of device companies in U.S., Europe, China, Taiwan, Mexico, Canada and Japan, ranging from simple devices to implants like stents, heart valves, brain, knee and new innovative amazing devices. Prior to that, I worked in device companies in U.S. I know, India does not have Medical Device companies. One time, while inspecting a giant Indian drug company, I asked that question to the founder. He told me that devices are cheaper to import from Europe so why bother? Korea, China are catching up with Europe but Germany, England, Ireland are on top. Switzerland and Germany started making knives and watches,with minute parts in old days and therefore, for the surgical devices, those countries are on top. In Germany, one whole city is an incubator of device companies. Many huge companies there started from every household car garage. In Germany, government made a law that device and other tech companies are required to provide a year or more internship to the Engineering and Science students in their companies. Large companies have replica of whole production plant on a small scale for students to learn and develop devices, make devices and have hands on experience. Therefore, many young Engineers start making devices as soon as they graduate from their garage. I was very impressed. In Israel, the commune living (kibbutism) provides guidance, innovative ideas and helps young people to develop latest technologies. I worked with excellent Israeli and Russian Scientists and Engineers, who developed devices. Also, all students in Israel are required to spend two years in Military, where they get training in all new technologies, innovations and not only for fighting only but many products are developed there. Singapore started the same. Indian government should look into this. In India, first of all the quality is not there. Even for simple household things, there is no quality at all. For example, every time I use pressure cooker to cook, the handle falls off, not having proper screws ( I tried three cookers and all with same problem). The door knobs, hinges gets tarnished and screws fall. You can easily notice the quality. Indian people are good with hands, India has so many artistic talents but lack modern and latest machinery and equipment and people don’t pay attention to detail and are not quality oriented (Ye to chalega, isme kya? attitude). Even simple things, like ladies sandles/shoes look very pretty and well designed but are very uncomfortable to wear. Fabric is good but stitching comes out or button falls. India has so many opportunities in device field. Presidents and owners from China, Taiwan and other countries ask me if I can help them set up a company in India or be a partner to start one there but I am afraid that living in U.S .for almost forty years, I don’t know how the life will be in India, dealing with government officers and people I hear is not easy. Especially, I do not believe in bribes and other unethical practices and if depend on other people, they step on your toes. The reasons India does not have device companies are: 1) Device industry requires many costly equipment and set up. People can not afford that and if get used, cheaper machinery then the repair and downtime affects the business. 2) The infrastructure issues, government interfering etc. I know a company in India, which manufactures devices in India, ship to U.S. and as it comes, devices are stamped as “ Made in U.S.”, ships back there. When I asked, the president told me that they can get more money and government charges tax, if they make in India and sell there as made in India, whereas, on imports, they don’t have to pay the local tax (I am not sure if this is true or not) but I believe, Indian wealthy people can pay four times more if it says, “Made in U.S.”. 3) Raw material /resources to import to make devices can be costly. 4) Affordability. People don’t use that many home devices in India like blood pressure monitors, blood glucose monitors etc.. 5) Monopoly of large international device companies of surgical devices. For example, mostly all U.S. and European companies have their local offices in India and so shipping as needed is more convenient then establishing whole plant and tomorrow if government makes different rules and regulations, their investment will go away. 6) International companies give many incentives and money to the doctors and hospitals in India. So, they only use their devices. I experienced this as one of my own family member needed a heart valve in Mumbai. I had inspected all major heart valve companies and I knew, one company had many issues with their heart valve products. My colleague and I stopped their one particular type of heart valve due to the design deficiencies. I told the doctor not to use that company’s device but use the other company’s device. I talked to both companies technical experts too for the condition of the patient and suitability of the type of heart valve. The Indian doctor first of all, would not talk to me and then when he did, he was very rude and slapped back at me saying who are you to tell me what to use? My family member died with the bad heart valve. I bet, the heart valves we stopped in U.S., they might be shipping to India. Doctors don’t tell patient’s family what they use. Many U.S. and international companies ship their rejected devices to India, which are cheaper and Indian people still can pay high price, thinking it is made in ……. . A friend of mine died in India who had stage “0” breast cancer and even though she had her treatments at top ranked hospital in Mumbai and had all brand name chemo drugs for her treatment, she and her husband paid four times than the ordinary person can pay. After a year she died of cancer due to cancer spreading. I am still suspicious that either she did not get proper radiation therapy or got fake or diluted chemo drugs. Once when I was a Director in a device company, I had a meeting with my Switzerland General Manager who told me about the issues we had with out implants. My staff also confirmed it in U.S. and I rejected a lot of devices. My CFO (Chief Financial Officer) told me to release the rejected implants and sign off to release the lot since it would have been a huge financial loss. When I refused, he came to see me from our corporate office and forced me to sign, saying that they will ship devices to third world countries and will not sale in U.S. or in Europe. I told my CFO that I came from third world country and that, if he would need implant and would have lived in my country, how would he feel? and that I will not sign off until I talk to my divisions President, whom I reported to. I called my President and explained about my decision (at that time, he was on a business trip to South Africa and Russia). He supported my decision and told me not to sign off the release. Unfortunately, when he came back, we both were fired from the job and were told that Board of Directors made that decision. I did not care losing job and I will still stand up for the honesty and oppose wrongdoing. My President succeeded in founding other companies and I got better job offer too. Another reason, India is a huge market for devices but people can not afford hospital stay cost and device costs, where majority of the devices are used and people who can afford, trust foreign devices more (According to Indian doctor friend who owns hospital in India). More people in India dies in hospitals then come home recovered fully then the people from U.S. hospitals. It is sad that many young people in India dies of heart attacks and not getting stents right away, whereas in U.S. heart attacks are not fatal. Unlike Pharma, where, majority of the Indian drug companies make more money from U.S. and not from India, U.S. market is self sufficient for the devices and can make cheaper devices in Ireland (Ireland government gives a huge tax break), Puerto Rico and Mexico, which are around the corner and not too far from U.S. China and Korea are growing fast in Biotech and device area. However, if the current U.S. politics may hurt the trade for other countries. India must improve the quality. If any body wants to make devices in India, I can help.

column1: Am I a bad person for feeling releaved my moms cat died?
column3: It's natural, when a family member, such as the family pets, get sick and SUPER high maintenance, to feel relief at being able to “let go” and continue with your daily life. Your kitty lived a LONG time — cats are the WORST PATIENTS! So please give yourself credit for your intensive care giving…NOT an EZ task AT ALL! Stay POSITIVE, you're clearly NOT A “BAD” person, after taking over for your mother to care for your family kitty with medications, etc. Taking care of our senior family members can be overwhelming as well. Take care of YOU -- clear away the “stuff” and cat belongings -- and move on! Take breaks and self -pamper, now that you need time to recover. You did your BEST, your conscience should be CLEAR. Now is the time to re- focus on your own needs. My sympathies for the loss of your family kitty… nobody could have done more.

column1: Which coping skills have worked the best for you when you’ve dealt with loss?
column3: For me personally these habits helped me deal with the pain of losing my man. It is very very difficult to put into words the pain and absolute anguish your body and mind go through. The nearest I can come to describing the loss is that it felt like an axe slicing through the soul. My appetite went for the first months and I literally lived on tea , toast and ginger biscuits .Every thing else just caused nausea. It was fine.. listen to your body .Don't force feed or overeat as some people do Visit or don't visit Grave..follow your instinct .Personally I found a great comfort especially in the first two years would sit pray cry chat. This was my personal time with him and looking back I think It has helped me the most. Minimum 8 hours sleep per night..after the funeral andpeople move on with their livescsi get into the habit..this is so very important . Your mind, body and soul need the rest. I personally like lots of photos reminders around me . Some I put away others and then new ones are found and displayed..follow your instinct. When the tears come and they will big fat ones that seem to come from a giant pool which is you.. let them flow. We cry because we loved them so much Avoid alcohol and drugs helps in the short-term but not the long. Whatever emotions come forth let them come and wash over you. They pass and flow.after time they ease in intensity . We all have secrets thoughts and places where we do connect .( dreams , songs) . These are personal don't share. And the main skill I have developed is prayer and meditation I also found reading certain books helpful. I try to set aside at least half an hour a day for prayer and at least 10 mins of yoga per day. I know that they haven't gone but moved onto a new dimension and we are all heading there one day !! So it's ok to grieve and honour our loss whilst at the same time supporting ourselves with Self care for the life we have now . And it's not for wimps!! It is the hardest stage of life we will all face which is why self care is so important and for me that included limiting contact with negative family members.

column1: How can choosing a wrong life partner ruin your whole life?
column3: I insist you guys to read fully. This is climactic as well since it is a weird concoction of highly incompatible girl and evil family members. *****************BEGINNING************************ I was heading for an arrange marriage considering my previous love failure. My parents were expecting me to get married. Moreover, I too realised that I am getting 27 this year and it is not at all early. So, I saw and talked to a girl whose match was suggested by our mutual relatives. We talked for a month on phone and she seemed quite normal( although bit obsolete and lagging in knowledge and intellect, but hey! who considers that in prospect wife?). She seemed like-minded, supportive and modern. One day I asked her if she had any relation in the past, to which, she affirmed that she dated a guy from college days and relationship lasted for approximately 5 years after which, the boy eventually married a girl of her mom's choice. But she assured me that she is completely out of it which, I believed and we proceeded to Roka ceremony and other customs. Our marriage date was fixed seven months later. ****************HAPPY PHASE******************* First four months went almost fine as she was seemingly compromising and flexible in nature. She used to talk in romantic tone and she was getting involved with me deeper with each passing day. She used to dicsuss events with me. However, I had some intuitions in mind though, which I ignored. In the past too, I had some unpleasant subconscious call and it turned out to be true later on. ***********TRAUMA BEGINS******************* From the sixth month onwards, her behaviour started taking 180 degree turn and it started worrying me about future of our marriage. She turned emotionless and while talking, she seemed as if she is not marrying by her choice. One day she tells me I don't have that madness. I am a very simple guy. I began to wonder she still misses her ex. Other day she complaints that I rely on my mother to form decisions and I should stop it. She told me not to spend money on my mother and sister except for occasional birthday gifts. Perhaps, my intuitions got true. She was valuing money, materials and envies from her rich friends more than a person. She used to compare me with her friends' fiance every single time no matter how silly comparisons might be, for e.g. she says my friend's fiance has given his credit card to her and she spends lavishly. She insisted that I must spend around 10–15k rupees on her on every meeting. She asked me to get a car, to which, I suggested that we can buy it 5–6 months later since our new home is built recently and I am a bit short on finances. Moreover, I have a brand new 250CC sporty bike and no commuting problem would be faced. She got annoyed and she frustratingly told me- “rehne do. Tumse na ho paayega. Me apne paiso ki le lungi”. She repeated this line multiple times. I went to chemist for sedatives. It lasted for one month with a lot of similar arguments and total lack of compromises and tantrums from her side. It started eating up my office space. Being a developer, I am supposed to stay active and focussed. But I could not concentrate on code and my projects continually got delayed to which, I was reprimanded heavily by my manager. I spent endless nights awake, worrying how this marriage will sustain. At last, I called off this marriage and informed my final decision to my family members. That doesn't end the problems here. Her family members tried their best to convince me and my kins to accept this marriage by pathetic justifications from the girl's side but in vain. Then they showed their real face. They got frustrated and warned us of legal repercussions. They told they would ask for a hefty amount of money to settle it otherwise they will approach court and police. This shook me and my family to the core since we have never even remotely been involved in legal matters. In an Indian judiciary system, even a false confession from the girl can put whole family of boy behind bars. If the boy is lucky enough, he will prove his innocence years later but with total loss of reputation in society and bank balance. Thanks to our relatives who helped us come out of this abyss by diplomatically taking this matter into their hands. Although we had to bear financial losses, it was settled at home. But this storm was so severe and lasted for nearly 40 days so much so that it left me and my family members in tears. It took me an another month to regain my composure at office. My friend-cum-colleague helped me in office problems and cases since he was the only one fully aware of the plights we had to go through. *********AFTERMATH CONSEQUENCES************* My mom has got many matches for me afterwards and she continually insists me to get married. But deep inside, I am emotionally drained, having seen the ugly side of both the girl and her family. I wonder I will never be able to trust any girl in future since I had to see such shit after 5 long months of happy phase. ************”ADDITIONAL INFORMATION************ In case some of you think I might have been a dull, boring and a languid guy who doesn’t charm and love her girl the way she likes to be, please listen me out. I am a musician as hobbist and sketch maker. I used to play romantic bollywood songs ranging from Late Mohammad Rafi's to contemporary Arijit Singh's best collections. She used to get mesmerized and excited so much so that she started dancing when I played despacito and senorita. She used to request me every single day to play songs of her choice and mine too. I used to make 3-D beautiful cards for her and present to her on every meeting we used to have. Besides these efforts, I bought her an insta camera worth Rs. 12000 on her birthday and on other occasions, perfumes, frerro rocher chocolates and expensive crafty photo frames. I played every role impressively, be it a responsible future husband or an attractive, handsome and caring boyfriend and that too, in an arrange marriage. I wasn't head over heels in love with her but I did everything that comforts her, warms her and excites her. She used to say in ecstasy that I am the best dating and husband material. Alas! What did I get? So much of pain along with my family suffering as bonus. And all of this just because she compared everything with what others do and may be I don’t( completely ignoring what I do offer and others even can't)? She had not yet moved on from her previous love( as she eventually confessed it at the final meet). She was mentally and emotionally very unstable. ***************TAKE AWAY********************** If I were to give my cents on what to consider while choosing partner, Pre-marriage phase is something joyful, merrier and exciting where both the persons should be absolutely sure. Financial problems may come which can be solved together. However, if the partner is indulged in excessively drawing comparisons to the extent that your contributions, no matter how big and valuable, are easily over shadowed by her pettiest comparisons, it means she can never value a person in her life. Also, if one had been in a long-term relation before, be circumspect while making further decision since there are a lot of cases nowadays where partner, especially girl, is definitely with you physically, but mentally she is still with her ex. Conduct an enquiry with her friends, office mates if possible. Family enquiry is not sufficient in this case. Even the nicest parents would never know how undesirable and unacceptable their girl is becoming. **************CONCLUSION********************** A wrong partner can give:Hell lot of insecurities, self doubt and trust issues to you for the years to come.Torture and sufferings to your family as well.Tensions to your friends too since they have to support you when you crash in such phase.Financial loss.Months and years of precious and limited life.Sometimes I just imagine- What if I were married to her? I would have been a drunkard, chain smoker, patient or even DEAD by now. At last, fortune mercied my mom and spared her from forthcoming tragedy and grief. Despite all of this, I feel lucky not to have got married to her. Thanks Quorans!!!!
column9: To be honest, the whole idea of an arranged marriage terrifies me. Since it’s the parents checking background, etc. their values will be relying heavily on how others see the families, not the person’s actual personality. Any adult knows that one’s parents don’t get to see the REAL you after a certain age. No thanks. I’ll choose my own spouse, thank you very much. Another cultural difference is that any potential husband who was that attached to his mother would be dumped in short order, here in America. Here, parental attachments are viewed as weak and inappropriate. Once you are with a mate, your job is to pay attention to her instead. Obviously, this woman was a terror. I’m curious. What did you mean that she was “obsolete?” I’ve never heard that used toward a human being, especially when you said right afterward that she was also “modern.”

column1: What specific things or experiences in your life have convinced you that Jehovah is real?
column3: When I first studied with the Witnesses I was a really stroked fire. I burned like a wind whipped fire to save the world and especially my immediate family. I was doing GOD’s work. My new passion became this good cause that was both logical, and benevolent. I studied constantly with a sincere delight in learning the deeper things of the Bible. I was a modern day hero, cape and all and totally determined to save the world I was staring in my own personal crusade. I wore the Bible truths like a garment of power. And used it relentlessly. Have you noticed my not mentioning GOD much in those first few paragraphs? Where I was only focusing on me? And you would be ‘right on the money’. GOD was a distant elusive possibility. But GOD wasn’t really real to me, I had trouble seeing him as he was invisible. For a lot years I continued my self righteous course. My love of knowledge about the Bible kept me afloat as a Witness. I had a couple of serious tests but I was unwavering in my determination that I HAD THE TRUTH. GOD was out there. Then the real test happened, three of my beloved close family members got disfellowshipped, all at once. If that wasn’t bad enough my mother died, then two of the disfellowhipped got into serious legal trouble. Due to the recession my business was in the toilet and very close to being flushed. I looked but I couldn’t see Jehovah anywhere because his help was missing, or so I thought. I became mentally and emotionally exhausted. The people I cared most about were not going to be in the New World, so I decided I was going to ‘eat to eat drink and be merry’ and go to Hell with a backpack. Why not? Since this is where all my family and friends were going. I might as well join them in the common grave. I felt this all powerful GOD Jehovah didn’t care about me. It was way past time for me to move on past this religious thing. I needed to live the real life of freedom. No more limits. During my time away from Jehovah, I rediscovered my old families culture of reading fortunes. I dabbled in this for entertainment and started telling fortunes for friends. They would come back later and tell he how accurate I had been. I would laugh and think the law of averages meant my guesses had to be right a few times. So, ‘no big deal’. Right? Wrong! Finally, after playing the odds with this activity, I soon grew bored with this shallow lifestyle. In my restless world I still needed some purpose greater than the one I was living. Sure I had my career, lots of free thinking friends, a big bite of the lifestyle that is found in a few places in Southern California. And it wasn’t enough. It was a thin shinny glamorous veneer covering desperation for me and most of my new friends. Not a real freedom. I finally, grieved the loss of my family’s disfellowhipping and out of desperation I finally decided I needed to pray to see what happens. Hello GOD! Are you really out there for me? I remember saying to a friend I’m going to a Sunday meeting at the Kingdom Hall, no matter what. I remember waking up and trying to get up and I just couldn’t move. So I went back to sleep. The next week, I tried again, and again something really powerful held me back. So this time I decided to pray out loud to Jehovah for the strength and the power to attend the meeting. And surprise of surprises; it worked. So there you have it folks! Prayers to Jehovah has been how he has become real to me. As Christians we sometimes take things for granted and neglect to pray to Jehovah. Prayer is the only way we can maintain a close relationship with our GOD Jehovah. Prayer and Jehovah’s many answers to our prayers proves he is real and is a hearer of prayers. Unless we pray, we will never have a real close relationship with GOD. Good relationships are based on good communications. After I repented and returned to Jehovah I no longer serve Jehovah only from the head intellectually, but from the heart too. I can now serve him like a banked fire that stays lit by Jehovah’s Holy Spirit. My faith is fed through prayers to Jehovah one day at a time. And he is real to me. And I have found the real freedom where people can find happiness.
column9: Prayer to Jehovah, through Jesus has helped me in my struggles and trials also. I started to pray incessantly during certain bad times and he was always there to comfort me. He was there to save my life when I thought I would not make it, or evan want to at times. I had to pray I would not get hit by a car on a pretty dangerous road/hwy while riding my bike in record heat for 6 months. That was not by choice. At that time, I realized all I really had was my bike, my straw hat, and my God! He listened, he heard me, he answered. Every time. One of the best things I like to describe about “The Hearer of Prayer”, Jehovah God, and his son Jesus, is on the many nights I prayed myself to sleep. I literally had held on to my bible, talking to God in prayer thinking I'll never get to sleep. Thats when I started to build faith in him. But I would become so comforted I would wake up the next day and realize I just fell asleep out of nowhere. It's true that prayer to him, and only him is the only way to have a relationship with our Creator. He works in amazing ways!😊

column1: As a person on the ASD spectrum, why am I crying over the loss of a pet? I understand why I am bereft, but not why it gets a physical expression that I am not deliberately choosing to make.
column3: Sometimes our reactions to our emotions are out of our control. If you’re on the spectrum, you’ve probably had a meltdown or a shutdown when things just got too much for you. You might have curled up on the ground and cried, or just run flat-out away from whatever was making you uncomfortable; you might have yelled or hit anything that came near you. Or maybe, especially if you’re an adult, you tend toward sitting and staring into the distance, shut down and unable to think or talk very well. That’s what happens when our brains just can’t process our surroundings anymore. Well, emotions do the same thing. It’s a lot of information to process. Your brain’s been overwhelmed, and your reaction is automatic, whether-you-like-it-or-not, kind of the way it’s usually automatic to yell when you’ve just hit your thumb with the hammer. (Well, it is for most people. I know some ASD people forget to express pain sometimes; I know I do. But losing a family member, even an animal, is a lot more painful than hitting your thumb with a hammer—the pain just isn’t physical.) When you’re very sad, you may find yourself having a meltdown or shutdown just like you do when you’re cognitively overwhelmed. You can’t process that information, so you cry uncontrollably. Or you may go into emotional shock, living on autopilot or losing self-care skills. You probably get exhausted after having been forced to socialize intensively for too long—well, emotional overload can do that too. It happens to neurotypicals as well; in fact, emotional overload is one of the few situations in which neurotypicals experience meltdowns. NTs would see it as completely normal for a widow to break down at a funeral and be unable to stop crying. They would comfort her in neurotypical fashion, with physical contact and talking, but they would be sympathetic. As time passes, your emotions will become less intense. You will probably always be sad about losing your pet, but you have happy memories with that pet, and those will start to come to the front of your mind more often. You’ll remember the good times as well as the heartbreak, and you’ll think of your sadness less and less. You’ll be able to go back to living your life, eventually unimpaired by grief; but you’ll have been forever changed because you knew that pet that you lost, and you’re a slightly different person because you did. I lost my first pet, a cat I unimaginatively named Tiger, when I was eleven years old. I cried for days, and then felt sad for weeks. But nowadays, what I remember most is bottle-feeding Tiger when she was a kitten, seeing her grow, and then learning from her what cats were about. She died when she was still quite young because she had feline leukemia, but I’ll always remember her, and I’ll always be a little bit different than I would have been if I had never known her. Today, because of Tiger, I’ve worked at cat shelters and fostered cats who needed a place to stay. I have two cats of my own, and both are good friends to me. I know I’ll probably lose them someday because cats don’t live as long as humans do, but in the long term it’s worth it. That doesn’t make it any better when you are curled up and crying because you have just lost a dear friend, but even the fact that you are grieving is evidence of how close you and your pet were to each other.
column9: That’s an excellent answer, I see how it makes sense, and indeed I often manifest “shutdown” by staring into the distance. I had that very discussion with my wife about this reaction, I just can’t talk just now, or remember to frown, sometimes. Of course one of the worst things about this is all the people trying to comfort me. I know they feel like it helps, but instead it makes things worse. Your description suggests that the reason this is so is that it’s contributing to the overload, and that feels… exactly right. I don’t miss my pet any more than I did before, but I really start to go hazy and wish they’d stop, it’s just too much.

column1: How did the Uyghur tribunal work?
column3: The so-called "Uyghur Tribunal" is neither legal nor credible, but just another anti-China farce concocted by a few individuals with the end goal of using Xinjiang to contain China. This so-called "tribunal" is not a judicial organ or procedure as the term suggests, noting that it is composed of people with ulterior motives and carries no weight or authority. The pseudo tribunal puts together a group of individuals who make a living out of demonizing China. the World Uyghur Congress, an organization dedicated to separating Xinjiang from China. The so-called "experts" and "witnesses" include Adrian Zenz, who has long been spreading lies about Xinjiang, as well as several "actors" who have been found to be habitually fabricating all sorts of "persecution" stories that never happened. Its "chair" Geoffrey Nice used to be a British agent, who is known for filing frivolous lawsuits, and has close ties with various anti-China forces.Adrian Zenz - WikipediaGerman anthropologist (born 1974) Adrian Nikolaus Zenz [ 2 ] (born 1974 [ 3 ] ) is a German anthropologist known for his studies of the Xinjiang internment camps and persecution of Uyghurs in China . [ 4 ] He is a director and senior fellow in China studies at the Victims of Communism Memorial Foundation , an anti-communist think tank established by the US government and based in Washington, DC. [ 5 ] [ 6 ] [ 7 ] Career Zenz received [ when? ] a master's degree in development studies from the University of Auckland , after which he managed development projects in China. [ 8 ] [ 9 ] He later [ when? ] earned a PhD in social anthropology from the University of Cambridge , with a doctoral thesis on minority education, job opportunities, and the ethnic identity of young Tibetans in western China. [ 10 ] [ 11 ] He is fluent in Mandarin Chinese . [ 11 ] He was a lecturer in social research methodology at the European School of Culture and Theology, [ 5 ] [ 12 ] a joint venture between the Evangelical theological institution Akademie für Weltmission [ de ] and Columbia International University , [ 13 ] [ 14 ] where he advised doctoral students. [ 15 ] In 2018, he moved to the United States. [ 16 ] As of 2021, he was a senior fellow in China studies at the Victims of Communism Memorial Foundation , [ 5 ] [ 7 ] and he served as an advisor to the Inter-Parliamentary Alliance on China . [ 7 ] [ 15 ] Anthropology Xinjiang Zenz's most influential work has been his research on the mass detention of Uyghurs and other Turkic Muslim minorities within China's Xinjiang internment camps . [ 1 ] He was one of the first researchers to reveal the existence, size, and scope of these camps. [ 1 ] [ 17 ] [ 18 ] Zenz's work on the detention of Uyghurs in Xinjiang began in February 2018 [ 1 ] and has been based on Chinese government budget plans, bidding papers, leaked documents, spreadsheets, and other official documents. [ 1 ] [ 19 ] [ 20 ] [ 21 ] In a May 2018 report published by the Washington, D.C.–based Jamestown Foundation , Zenz initially estimated the number of detained Muslims to range from 100,000 to just over 1 million. [ 1 ] He based this estimate on documents published by Istiqlal, a Turkey-based Uyghur exile media organization, which had reportedly been leaked by anonymous Chinese public security officials in the region, along with two reports on Muslim detention quotas by Shohret Hoshur for Radio Free Asia . [ 22 ] [ 23 ] [ 24 ] [ 25 ] [ 26 ] He then extrapolated from these figures and incorporated information from former detainees and public Chinese government documents that gave indications of the sizes and numbers of the camps. [ 1 ] [ 24 ] Since then, his estimate has been cited widely, with many sources, including experts on a United Nations human rights panel , preferring to use the higher end of the estimate's range, while other scholars have questioned its accuracy. In the 1983 United Kingdom general election and the 1987 United Kingdom general election , he was the unsuccessful Social Democratic Party candidate for Dover . He took part in the International Criminal Tribunal for the Former Yugoslavia and was lead prosecutor at Slobodan Milošević's 2002 trial. Between 2009 and 2012, he was Vice-Chair of the Bar Standards Board , the body that regulates barristers in England and Wales. In 2017, Nice published a book, "Justice for All and How to Achieve It". [ 1 ] In 2019 he chaired the China Tribunal , an independent people’s tribunal [ citation needed ] established to inquire into forced organ harvesting from prisoners of conscience in China. In 2021 he chaired the Uyghur Tribunal , which examined evidence regarding the ongoing human rights abuses against the Uyghur people by the Government of China . In 2005 Nice received an Honorary Doctorate of Law from the University of Kent at Canterbury , and in 2021 he received an Honorary Doctorate of Law from the University of Buckingham . Nice's family home was in Catford , England, [ 2 ] where he attended St Dunstan's College , and later Keble College, Oxford . He became a barrister in 1971 and was appointed Queen's Counsel in 1990. From 1984 to 2014 he was a part-time judge at the Old Bailey . [ 3 ] [ 4 ] Nice was made a Knight Bachelor in 2007. [ 5 ] In 2009, he was named Vice-Chair of the Bar Standards Board . In 2012 he was appointed the Professor of Law at Gresham College , a position formerly occupied by Baroness Deech . [ 4 ] [ 6 ] In the 1983 United Kingdom general election and 1987 United Kingdom general election , he was the unsuccessful Social Democratic Party candidate for Dover . [ 7 ] Nice has been involved with the International Criminal Tribunal for the Former Yugoslavia (ICTY). He was lead prosecutor at the 2002 trial of Slobodan Milošević in The Hague and initiated the prosecution's initial case of linking atrocities committed in the former Yugoslavia to Milosevic. His contract in that case ended in 2006. [ 8 ] He prosecuted the ICTY cases of the Bosnian Croat Dario Kordić and the successful prosecution of Goran Jelisić . Nice has been active in the International Criminal Court (ICC) and in pro bono work for victims groups. [ 4 ] His practice includes human rights/public law and personal injury . [ 5 ] In February 2009 he represented Omar al-Bashir , and tried but failed to block the ICC cases against Bashir; the ICC issued an arrest warrant for al-Bashir the following month on counts of war crimes and crimes against humanity .
